boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along McMinnville corridors within the practical orbit of Linfield University, each paired with one source-backed reason to go.

cards.title: Browse New and Used Shelves
cards.subtitle: On NE Third Street in historic downtown
cards.notes: Walk NE Third Street to browse both new and used books; check the shop’s posted daily hours before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: An independent downtown stop for general-interest reading and gift browsing.
cards.evidence_claim: Third Street Books is an independent general-interest bookstore at 320 NE Third Street offering new and used books, cards, and gifts.
cards.access_notes: 320 NE Third Street; the business page lists daily hours of 10 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: See Work by Oregon Artists
cards.subtitle: On NE Third Street’s gallery corridor
cards.notes: Step into the artist-owned gallery during posted hours and scan its changing displays across several visual-art media.
cards.short_summary: A Third Street gallery representing dozens of artists from Oregon.
cards.evidence_claim: Currents Gallery is an artist-owned gallery at 532 NE Third Street representing more than 60 Oregon artists in media including painting, ceramics, wood, and photography.
cards.access_notes: 532 NE Third Street; the gallery lists Tuesday–Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–3 p.m.

cards.title: Survey More Than 50 Vendors
cards.subtitle: On NE Third Street’s retail blocks
cards.notes: Use the Third Street stop to compare the mall’s vendor booths, from jewelry and clothing to furniture and household pieces.
cards.short_summary: A multi-vendor antique mall occupying a large downtown storefront.
cards.evidence_claim: McMinnville Antiques Mall is located at 334 NE Third Street and contains more than 50 vendors selling items such as jewelry and retro furniture.
cards.source_title: Wine Country Antiques and Sustainable Shopping
cards.access_notes: 334 NE Third Street; confirm current business hours directly before visiting.

cards.title: Use Wi-Fi and Study Resources
cards.subtitle: Beside the NW Adams Street corridor
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or study materials to the upstairs information area; verify the day’s library hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A public Carnegie-library complex with study-supporting technology.
cards.evidence_claim: McMinnville Public Library is at 225 NW Adams Street and provides public internet computers, free Wi-Fi, and electrical outlets.
cards.access_notes: 225 NW Adams Street; current contact page lists Tuesday–Saturday hours and closure Sunday–Monday.

cards.title: Follow the Park’s Walking Paths
cards.subtitle: Along NW Park Drive beside downtown
cards.notes: Enter from the downtown side for paved paths, then continue toward Cozine Creek and the lower park’s soft-surface trails.
cards.short_summary: A historic city park combining paths, creekside space, and recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: City Park is adjacent to historic downtown and provides 0.75 mile of paved walkways, 0.30 mile of soft-surface trails, picnic areas, and courts.
cards.access_notes: Adjacent to historic downtown; pets are prohibited in upper-park areas, while leashed dogs are allowed only in the lower park.

cards.title: Check the Weekly Swim Schedule
cards.subtitle: On NW Park Drive at City Park
cards.notes: Review the current weekly schedule before walking over; program times vary, and swimming requires the facility’s posted admission.
cards.short_summary: A municipal pool complex with scheduled swimming and instruction.
cards.evidence_claim: McMinnville Aquatic Center is located at 138 NW Park Drive and publishes admission fees, weekly schedules, swimming lessons, and training information.
cards.access_notes: 138 NW Park Drive; consult the current weekly schedule and admission-fee page before visiting.

cards.title: Catch a Community Production
cards.subtitle: On NE Ford Street near Third Street
cards.notes: Check the production calendar first, then approach from Third Street; show-week box-office hours differ from regular hours.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit community theater presenting performances for broad audiences.
cards.evidence_claim: Gallery Theater operates at 210 NE Ford Street as a nonprofit performing-arts organization serving people of all ages and lists regular showtimes.
cards.access_notes: 210 NE Ford Street; posted performances are Friday and Saturday at 7:30 p.m. and Sunday at 2 p.m., subject to the current production calendar.

cards.title: Find a Parks Program Downtown
cards.subtitle: On NE Evans Street’s civic corridor
cards.notes: Use the city’s activity listings to choose a program before walking to Evans Street; schedules and eligibility vary by activity.
cards.short_summary: The downtown base for municipal recreation programs and community activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of McMinnville identifies the Community Center at 600 NE Evans Street and lists it as a Parks and Recreation facility.
cards.access_notes: 600 NE Evans Street; contact Parks and Recreation or consult its activity listings before attending a program.

cards.title: Walk the Seasonal Market Stalls
cards.subtitle: Along Cowls Street near First Street
cards.notes: Go on a listed market Thursday and walk the Cowls Street stalls; confirm the season date before making the trip downtown.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal downtown market for regional farm goods and handcrafted wares.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 McMinnville Downtown Farmers Market is held Thursdays from May 21 through October 22 at First and Cowls streets.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal destination at First and Cowls streets; the 2026 season runs Thursdays, May 21–October 22.

cards.title: Watch the Roaster at Work
cards.subtitle: On NE Alpine Avenue in the Granary District
cards.notes: Follow Alpine Avenue to the café and look toward the roasting area; whether production is visible depends on operations that day.
cards.short_summary: A Granary District café with an on-site coffee-roasting operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Flag & Wire Coffee is located at 755 NE Alpine Avenue, Suite 100, and its café includes a nearby roaster that visitors can sometimes see operating.
cards.access_notes: 755 NE Alpine Avenue, Suite 100; the business lists daily hours of 7 a.m.–2 p.m.
